title: Hidden Dangers: Study Finds Toxic Chemicals in Everyday Products
subtitle: New research shows that many personal care items contain ingredients not listed on their labels.

summary.en: A new study has discovered that many personal care products contain toxic chemicals that are not listed on their packaging. Researchers tested over 110 items, including shampoos and baby lotions, and found hidden substances in the vast majority. These chemicals are linked to serious health issues like cancer and reproductive harm. Even products marketed as natural or eco-friendly were found to contain dangerous compounds. The findings have led experts to call for stricter government rules and mandatory safety testing.
summary.zh: 一項新的研究發現，許多個人護理產品含有未列在包裝上的有毒化學物質。研究人員測試了超過一百一十種商品，包括洗髮精與嬰兒乳液，並在絕大多數產品中發現了隱藏物質。這些化學物質與癌症及生殖系統損害等嚴重健康問題有關。即使是標榜天然或環保的產品，也被發現含有危險化合物。這些發現促使專家呼籲政府制定更嚴格的法規，並實施強制性的安全檢測。

paragraphs.en: When you buy a bottle of shampoo or a tube of lotion, you likely trust the list of ingredients on the back of the bottle. However, a new study suggests that this trust may be misplaced. Researchers recently tested more than 110 personal care products, ranging from baby lotions to soaps and toothpaste. The results were concerning: about 85% of the items contained toxic chemicals that were not listed on their labels.
paragraphs.zh: 當您購買一瓶洗髮精或一條乳液時，您很可能會信任瓶身背後的成分表。然而，一項新的研究顯示，這種信任可能放錯了地方。研究人員近期測試了超過一百一十種個人護理產品，範圍涵蓋嬰兒乳液、肥皂到牙膏。結果令人擔憂：約百分之八十五的產品含有標籤上未列出的有毒化學物質。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Health, the study used a broad testing method to look for thousands of different substances. They found an average of three times as many chemicals in the products as were actually listed by the manufacturers. Among the substances detected were hormone disruptors and carcinogens—substances that can cause cancer. These chemicals are linked to a variety of health problems, including neurological diseases and reproductive harm, especially in developing children.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報健康》（The Guardian Health）報導，該研究採用了一種廣泛的檢測方法來尋找數千種不同的物質。他們發現產品中實際含有的化學物質數量，平均是製造商所列出的三倍。在檢測出的物質中，包括了荷爾蒙干擾物與致癌物，這些物質可能引發癌症。這些化學物質與多種健康問題有關，包括神經系統疾病與生殖系統損害，特別是對發育中的兒童而言。

paragraphs.en: One of the most surprising findings was that even products labeled as “natural,” “green,” or “eco-friendly” were not always safe. The study found that 26% of these products contained at least one dangerous compound that contradicted their marketing claims. For example, some items labeled as “100% natural” actually contained synthetic chemicals. Jenna Hua, a lead author of the study and a representative from the testing company Million Marker, expressed frustration with the current situation. She noted that consumers are being misled when they pay for products they believe are safe.
paragraphs.zh: 最令人驚訝的發現之一是，即使是標榜「天然」、「綠色」或「環保」的產品，也未必安全。研究發現，這些產品中有百分之二十六含有至少一種與其行銷宣稱相矛盾的危險化合物。例如，某些標示為「百分之百天然」的商品，實際上卻含有合成化學物質。該研究的主要作者、檢測公司 Million Marker 的代表華珍娜（Jenna Hua）對現況表示沮喪。她指出，消費者在購買自認為安全的產品時，實際上正受到誤導。

paragraphs.en: Why are these chemicals present if they are not on the label? The researchers explained that the situation is complex. Some chemicals might be added illegally, while others could be the result of unintended reactions between ingredients during the manufacturing process. Additionally, some dangerous compounds may leak into the product from the plastic packaging itself. A major issue is the use of the word “fragrance” or “parfum” on labels. Under current laws, companies can hide any of 1,200 different chemicals under this single term without being more specific.
paragraphs.zh: 如果這些化學物質未列在標籤上，為何會出現在產品中？研究人員解釋，情況相當複雜。有些化學物質可能是非法添加的，而另一些則可能是製造過程中成分之間發生非預期反應的結果。此外，某些危險化合物可能會從塑膠包裝本身滲入產品中。一個主要問題是標籤上使用「香料」或「香精」這類詞彙。根據現行法律，企業可以將一千兩百種不同的化學物質隱藏在這一單一名稱之下，而無需進行更具體的說明。

paragraphs.en: This problem is not just about large corporations. According to The Guardian Health, some small businesses try to make clean products but are often let down by their suppliers. These companies may unknowingly buy contaminated raw materials or be lied to about the quality of the ingredients they receive. Many of these small producers are now afraid of being sued if they discover that their products are not as clean as they originally thought. Experts argue that stronger laws are necessary to help these businesses and to ensure that all products on the market are safe for the public.
paragraphs.zh: 這個問題不僅僅與大型企業有關。根據《衛報健康》報導，一些小型企業試圖製造純淨的產品，卻常被供應商所誤。這些公司可能在不知情的情況下購買了受污染的原料，或是被供應商欺騙了原料品質。許多小型生產商現在擔心，如果發現自己的產品不如原先想像的那麼純淨，可能會面臨訴訟。專家主張，必須制定更嚴格的法律來協助這些企業，並確保市面上所有產品對大眾而言都是安全的。

paragraphs.en: Currently, there is no requirement for companies to perform the kind of deep testing that this study conducted. The authors of the report believe that the government should introduce stricter oversight, including mandatory testing for all personal care goods. By requiring companies to prove their products are safe before they reach store shelves, regulators could create a fairer system for both businesses and consumers.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，並沒有規定要求企業執行這項研究所進行的那種深度檢測。該報告的作者認為，政府應引入更嚴格的監督機制，包括對所有個人護理商品進行強制性檢測。透過要求企業在產品上架前證明其安全性，監管機構可以為企業與消費者創造一個更公平的體系。

paragraphs.en: As the debate over product safety continues, the findings serve as a reminder for shoppers to be cautious. While it is difficult for an average person to know exactly what is inside every bottle, the researchers hope their work will push for better transparency in the industry. Million Marker is currently working to raise funds to continue this important testing, as they believe that everyone has the right to know what they are putting on their bodies. Until laws change, the study highlights a clear need for more accountability from the companies that make the products we use every single day.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著關於產品安全的辯論持續進行，這些發現提醒了消費者必須保持謹慎。雖然一般人很難確切知道每個瓶子裡裝了什麼，但研究人員希望他們的工作能推動產業提高透明度。Million Marker 目前正致力於籌集資金以繼續這項重要的檢測，因為他們相信每個人都有權知道自己塗抹在身體上的是什麼。在法律改變之前，這項研究凸顯了我們每天使用的產品製造商，必須負起更多責任的明確需求。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Used to describe a feeling or belief that is not appropriate or justified by the facts.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （信任、信心等）錯置的、不適當的。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（放錯地方），這裡形容信任感是錯誤的。文中：However, a new study suggests that this trust may be misplaced.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fail to support or help someone as they expected or needed.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 使……失望、辜負、未給予應有的支持。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指供應商未能達到標準，導致廠商受害。文中：some small businesses try to make clean products but are often let down by their suppliers.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The process of watching and directing an activity to ensure it is done correctly.
keyTerms.noteZh: 容易與「疏忽」（mistake）混淆，這裡指政府的監督管理。文中：The authors of the report believe that the government should introduce stricter oversight, including mandatory testing for all personal care goods.

quiz.question: According to the study, what percentage of products labeled as 'natural' or 'eco-friendly' contained ingredients that contradicted these claims?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段明確指出：「The study found that 26% of these products contained at least one dangerous compound that contradicted their marketing claims.」選項 A 是所有受測產品中含有未標示化學物質的比例，而非僅針對「天然」產品。選項 C 是錯誤的數學推論，選項 D 則是文章中提到的標籤字眼，並非實際數據。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why might a small business owner be concerned about the current state of the personal care industry?

options.A: They are worried that large corporations will force them to lower their prices.
options.B: They lack the technology to label their products as 'fragrance'.
options.C: They might unknowingly sell contaminated products and face legal consequences.
options.D: They are unable to afford the cost of the study conducted by Million Marker.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段，小企業常因供應商提供的原料品質不佳而受害，導致產品含有未預期的化學物質，文中明確提到這些生產者「are now afraid of being sued」，顯示其對法律責任的擔憂。選項 A 文中未提及。選項 B 與文章論點無關。選項 D 並非小企業的主要擔憂，他們擔憂的是產品安全與法律賠償。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'hide' mean in the context of the term 'fragrance'?

options.A: To intentionally conceal specific information from the public.
options.B: To physically place an object where it cannot be seen.
options.C: To protect a secret recipe from being stolen by competitors.
options.D: To remove harmful chemicals from the manufacturing process.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到公司利用「fragrance」這個詞彙，在法律允許下將 1,200 種不同的化學物質歸類在該術語下，而不需詳細列出，這是一種刻意隱瞞成分資訊的行為。選項 B 是該詞的字面義，但在本句中不適用。選項 C 雖涉及商業機密，但文章強調的是對消費者的不透明。選項 D 與事實相反，該行為反而掩蓋了有害物質的存在。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article?

options.A: Consumers should stop buying all personal care products immediately.
options.B: Small businesses are solely responsible for the lack of transparency in the industry.
options.C: The government has already implemented strict testing for all personal care goods.
options.D: Current regulations are insufficient to ensure product safety and transparency for consumers.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文的核心在於探討產品標示不實與隱藏化學物質的問題，並在最後幾段強調現行法律不足，呼籲政府應加強監管與強制測試以保護消費者。選項 A 過於極端。選項 B 錯誤，因為文章指出大企業與小企業都面臨挑戰。選項 C 與文章第六段提到的「there is no requirement for companies to perform the kind of deep testing」完全相反。
